name: Career Scout
tagline: Reads your CV, then ranks openings by how closely they really fit
description: You begin by handing over your resume, which it turns into a picture of what you can do and what you are looking for. Every vacancy it examines is then graded against that picture, and what comes back is a short ordered list worth your time rather than forty open tabs. Nothing about it assumes a particular industry.
author: Hojjat
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
